description: This Java class implements an exception mapper for handling AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException exceptions within the Fineract platform. It converts such exceptions into HTTP 404 responses with a standardized error payload.

classes.name: PlatformResourceNotFoundExceptionMapper
classes.description: A JAX-RS exception mapper that handles 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException' exceptions by returning a 404 HTTP response with a JSON error message.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException into an HTTP 404 Response with a standardized JSON error payload.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns a custom error code (1001) associated with this exception mapper.
